8-21. Prove that up to isomorphism, there are exactly one 1-dimensional Lie algebra and two 2-dimensional Lie algebras. Show that all three algebras are isomorphic to Lie subalgebras of $\mathfrak {{gl}}\left( {2,\mathbb {R}}\right)$ . \end{exercise}
